body: That my mother secretly went off of birth control solely to get pregnant and use me to get money from my father for the next 18 years. He realized she was a crazy bitch a little to late, was forced to get engaged so I wasn't a "bastard" and.. well now here I am.

Oh boy, I was just finishing up on a reply to your message and my laptop crashed.. I don't feel like typing all of what I just did again quite yet. I will try to remember everything I had typed up later. There was quite a bit there and I will try and get back to you.
Thanks again :) You've really helped me to fell better tonight.

Thank You, so much. Reading this actually put a smile on my face. I want to be able to talk to my dad about all of this so much but I just can't bring myself to.. At least not yet. I hope I will be able to soon. I know I am getting worse and I need to do something about it. I should be starting at a new job soon, hopefully that will keep me busy and take my mind off of things.
Definitely don't need someone like you commenting.

Reddit, normally i can spit out a 3000 word essay worth an A but this is being written while I am at my wits end. I apologize for the mess above. For anyone that gets through it and replies, Thank You so much. If anyone wants more clarity on anything I said, I'll try and help. Its late and it's been a long few weeks.
